blocks.html: Guards adjacent to seating in a building, room or space used for assembly purposes shall be provided where required by Section 1015 of this code and shall be constructed in accordance with Section 1015 except where provided in accordance with Sections 1029.16.1 through 1029.16.5 of this code. At bleachers, grandstands and folding and telescopic seating, guards must be provided where required by ICC 300 and Section 1029.16.1 of this code.
